title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：mud　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mud 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the ranger ① cleared the mud that no villager in the valley would have described, and he said the clearing was the whole of the season. The ② mud, meaning the soil itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; mud, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of mud in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ mud at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Mud, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the ranger said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mud was the whole of the matter, meaning the shame and not the soil. The ⑥ mud, meaning the shame and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; mud, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both soil and a shame. He said the shame is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ mud had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ mud of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of describing; mud, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mud I remember is the mud described in the survey, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Mud, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being described; all mud, she said, is a shame that has agreed to look like soil. She said the shame was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 泥；泥浆（指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 泥；泥浆（指那片泥本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the mud 清这一片泥
D. n. 泥；泥浆（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 泥之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的泥之事）
F. n. 泥；泥浆（指踏勘记录里写到、被描述的那一片）
G. n. 泥、狼狈（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 狼狈（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleared the mud that no villager in the valley would have described
The mud, meaning the soil itself and not the staff
Every sort of mud in that valley
the mud at the far ridge
the mud was the whole of the matter
the mud had become a line in a survey
The mud of the whole thing

answers.why: clear the mud 意为“清这一片泥”，1968 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯描述的一片泥做了一遍。
mud 意为“泥；泥浆”，指那片泥本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被描述。
mud 意为“泥；泥浆”，指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
mud 意为“泥；泥浆”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mud 意为“泥、狼狈”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片狼狈就是那件事的全部。
mud 意为“狼狈”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片泥，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mud 意为“泥；泥浆”，指踏勘记录里写到、被描述的那一片，到 1973 年这一片成了踏勘记录里的一行。
mud 意为“泥之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的泥之事是一处山谷和三个季节的描述。
mud 意为“泥；泥浆”，我记得的是踏勘记录里描述过的那一片，1975 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一片。
mud 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，泥是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的泥。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年那位守林人清了山谷里没有一位村民肯描述的一片泥，他说这一遍才是那个季节的全部。（clear the mud）
那片泥，指的是那片泥本身而不是短短的手杖，经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被描述。（mud）
那处山谷里每一类泥旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。（mud）
最远那道山脊那片泥，指的是他们留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（mud）
叔叔说这片狼狈就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那片泥。（mud）
1977 年母亲说，泥是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的泥。（mud）

Every sort of mud in that valley had the same short staff beside it.
The mud at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the mud was the whole of the matter, meaning the shame and not the soil.
